source_snapshot.procedure: Master sets OEM `ipmitool raw 0x30 0x21 0x01 0x64`, lists 0x14/0x32/0x46/0x5A/0x64 as 20/50/70/90/100 percent, then says raise 5 percent and inspect all fan speeds with `ipmitool sdr elist`.
source_snapshot.criteria: Fan speed in SDR increases when percentage increases; no fan-speed log while using manual setting.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL replaces the Master command with OEM `0x30 0x30 0x01 0x00 0xAA` and `0x30 0x30 0x02 0xff {duty}`, uses a fixed sleep and exposes credentials in arguments. It supplies no approved auto-restore bytes, controller scope, safe duty/dwell/thermal bounds or watchdog.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly treats the duty override as CRITICAL and requires exact vendor commands, per-run approval, bounded monitoring and unconditional auto restoration.

old_problem: The Master and DeepSeek specify incompatible OEM command families, the Master first sets 100 percent and then instructs an undefined 5 percent increase, the event-log criterion is ambiguous, and neither source supplies a proven automatic-control restore/readback command or independent thermal abort. These are core operation and recovery semantics, not mere runtime addresses or thresholds.
disposition_reason: No public IPMI or DMTF standard defines these vendor raw bytes, and the Project script URL is not an authoritative reviewed command specification in the repository. ED-03 forbids guessing OEM parameters, while ED-15 and the safety decisions forbid inventing response bands or recovery. The case therefore retains its full duty-change coverage and a review-layer execution contract, but remains non-executable until the platform owner resolves the exact command family, sequence, expected log semantics and guaranteed auto-mode recovery.
decision_basis: XLSX row 976, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 977 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 977 / variant 22873225f4ae3c0b.

IPMI v2.0 identifies OEM-specific functionality by manufacturer/product and requires a priori vendor knowledge to interpret it; the standard cannot validate `0x30/0x21` versus `0x30/0x30` or their payloads.

The literal Master sequence is internally impossible as written: after setting 0x64/100 percent, a 5 percent increase has no defined listed target. The listed points also are not five-percent increments.

The adjacent Auto-mode case uses Master `0x30 0x21 0x00`, while DeepSeek proposes `0x30 0x30 0x01 0x01`; adjacency exposes the same unresolved OEM family conflict and does not independently prove either recovery path.

ED-03, ED-05, ED-14, ED-15, ED-16, ED-17, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 require OEM authority, distinct active coverage, formal acceptance, safe recovery and preserved evidence; ED-34 through ED-38 require an approved tool/runbook, explicit confirmation and no automatic retry.

test_case.test_name: Verify bounded manual fan-duty response and guaranteed restoration to automatic closed-loop control
test_case.purpose: Under explicit per-run authorization, verify each approved manual fan-duty step changes every intended mapped tachometer response within its approved band and dwell without thermal or fan-control faults, then unconditionally restore and independently prove automatic closed-loop control; preserve the Master duty points pending owner resolution rather than substituting read-only telemetry.
required_package: Vendor/platform-owner specification tied to exact BMC manufacturer ID, product ID, model and firmware that defines set-duty, query-mode/query-duty and restore-auto commands byte-for-byte, completion codes and target scope
Owner resolution of Master `0x30 0x21...` versus DeepSeek `0x30 0x30...`, the 100-percent-then-raise contradiction, intended duty sequence and the meaning of `no FAN speed log`
Pinned reviewed Script commit/content and proof it implements the approved command family, protected credential handling, bounded timeout and finally-path recovery
Complete fan/controller/rotor/sensor topology and per-duty expected RPM response bands, allowed variance, stabilization dwell, monotonicity rule and required sensor freshness
Approved safe minimum/maximum duty, independent temperature/health/alarm limits, watchdog sample interval, abort conditions, isolation prerequisites and staffed incident runbook
Separate, previously validated auto-mode recovery/readback mechanism with fallback recovery and shutdown/escalation authority, plus explicit per-run user authorization
test_case.test_command: DO NOT EXECUTE while Pending. After all unblock evidence is versioned and an operator explicitly approves the exact run: verify immutable target/manufacturer/product/firmware and protected authentication; preserve baseline control-mode/duty, all mapped RPMs, temperatures, alarms and SEL/audit logs. Arm an independent watchdog and tested finally handler that issues the approved restore-auto command on success, error, disconnect or timeout. Apply only the owner-approved duty sequence one bounded step at a time—never infer bytes or a 5-percent step—record the exact response/completion code and sample every mapped fan plus independent temperatures/alarms throughout the approved dwell. Abort on any stale/missing sensor, fan stall, unexpected RPM/temperature trend, alarm, command ambiguity or session loss. In all paths restore automatic mode, prove it through an independent mode readback and temperature-driven behavior check, and preserve post-state/log evidence. Do not clear logs, expose credentials, retry automatically or leave manual override active.
test_case.expected_result: For every explicitly approved duty transition, the correct target/controller acknowledges the documented command and all intended fan channels respond monotonically within their approved per-step RPM bands and stabilization time while temperatures, health and alarms stay within limits. No event forbidden by the owner-resolved log criterion occurs. Automatic mode is restored on every exit path, independently read back, and closed-loop response plus final RPM/temperature/health/log state are acceptable with no residual override.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative byte-level command applicability, a resolved non-contradictory duty matrix, explicit per-run authorization, complete fan topology, per-step response bands/dwell, independent thermal watchdog, owner-defined log rule and verified automatic-mode restoration. Command completion, one sensor, a read-only substitute or increased aggregate RPM alone cannot pass. Any wrong/ambiguous command, unapproved target/duty, missing fan response, out-of-band/stale RPM or temperature, alarm, forbidden event or unverified restore is FAIL and stops the run. Until all core command, acceptance and recovery evidence exists, status remains ENGINEERING DECISION PENDING; no values are inferred.
safety_gate: Never execute during review and never execute an OEM raw command based only on Master, DeepSeek, adjacent-row or generic internet examples.
Match exact BMC manufacturer/product/firmware and independently validate set/query/restore commands before the run; use secret-safe authentication, not passwords in process arguments or artifacts.
Require explicit user confirmation immediately before each authorized state-changing run, a staffed abort owner, isolated approved SUT and no concurrent thermal/power workload.
Arm independent temperature/RPM/health/alarm watchdogs and a bounded command/dwell timeout before any manual override; failure of monitoring itself triggers restore and stop.

Use an unconditional finally path plus independent readback to restore automatic closed-loop control; if restore cannot be proven, follow the approved incident/shutdown runbook rather than improvising.
Preserve pre/during/post logs and evidence; do not clear logs, automatically retry, continue after anomaly or reduce the case to passive telemetry.
expected_evidence: Owner-signed command specification and conflict resolution tied to BMC identity/firmware, plus pinned reviewed Script and explicit per-run approval
Approved duty sequence, target map, RPM response bands, dwell, thermal/alarm limits, watchdog and incident/recovery runbook
Protected baseline control mode/duty, all mapped RPM/temperature/health/alarm values and preserved SEL/audit artifacts
Per-step command bytes/hash, completion response, timestamps, duty, full fan response, thermal trajectory, log result and abort decisions
Finally-path record, independent auto-mode readback, closed-loop behavior proof and healthy final state
Credential/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict
test_case.recovery: Use only the platform-owner-approved automatic-mode restore command in an armed unconditional finally path, then verify control-mode readback, all mapped fans, independent temperatures/alarms and final logs. If restore or telemetry cannot be verified, do not issue alternate guessed raw bytes or retry; invoke the staffed approved thermal incident/shutdown procedure, preserve evidence and escalate to the platform owner.

source_conflict.reason: Master and DeepSeek use incompatible OEM command families; Master's 100-percent-then-raise-5-percent sequence has no defined next state, and its `no FAN speed log` acceptance wording is ambiguous. No approved authority resolves these differences.

blocked.reason: The functional goal and a safe review-layer contract are clear, but execution awaits an explicit engineering decision on OEM bytes, sequence, acceptance and recovery. It remains Engineering Decision Pending rather than a separately classified permanent BLOCKED case.

pending.missing_evidence: Authoritative model/firmware-bound set/query/restore command specification; resolution of command families and duty sequence; log criterion; full response bands/dwell; independent watchdog and incident recovery; reviewed Script content; per-run approval model.
pending.responsible_owner: Platform BMC/thermal owner with firmware vendor and lab safety owner
pending.unblock_condition: Versioned approval of the exact command/sequence/expected results and demonstrated safe auto-restore/readback plus thermal abort runbook on the intended BMC firmware.
pending.execution_status: NOT EXECUTABLE; STATIC REVIEW ONLY; NO OEM COMMAND, FAN OVERRIDE, SENSOR QUERY, LOG CLEAR, RESET, POWER OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Establishes manufacturer/product identity for OEM-specific commands and that generic clients need prior vendor knowledge; it does not define either disputed fan-control byte sequence.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide 2025.3
external_authorities.application: Provides standard Fan, Sensor, Status and thermal telemetry semantics for monitoring; it does not authorize or define the OEM IPMI write command.

project_authority: Only the exact platform BMC/thermal owner and firmware-vendor specification can approve these OEM command bytes, target scope, response matrix and guaranteed recovery. This missing authority is core and cannot be converted into a runtime placeholder.
